claim: Dated pre-activation trilateral exercise, operational activation and later joint exercises are documented; independent performance and causal influence remain unmeasured.

observations.observed: US, Japan and ROK naval participants shared tactical data-link information in a missile-warning and search-and-tracking exercise.
observations.measurement: one documented pre-activation exercise; not an absence-of-cooperation baseline

observations.observed: Three defense ministries announced full activation of a continuous real-time DPRK missile-warning data-sharing mechanism after operational tests.
observations.sourcePublisher: Japan Ministry of Defense, joint trilateral statement
observations.measurement: activation date, not measured interception or response performance

observations.observed: First Freedom Edge trilateral multi-domain exercise commenced with ships and aircraft from all three countries, including ballistic missile defense training.
observations.measurement: one named multi-domain exercise commenced; not quantified warning-system performance

observations.observed: Defense ministers signed trilateral security cooperation framework, reaffirming continuation of missile-warning data sharing and exercises.
observations.measurement: signed cooperation framework, not independent policy change

observations.observed: Second Freedom Edge exercise commenced with specified ships and aircraft from all three countries.
observations.measurement: second named iteration commenced; not a second independent warning-network performance test

observations.observed: Japan Joint Staff announced third Freedom Edge iteration and approximately 700 Japanese personnel expected to participate.
observations.measurement: planned Japanese participant count only, not verified attendance or a three-country total

comparison.baseline: 2022 exercise shows pre-existing trilateral information sharing; avoid treating 2023 as the beginning of all cooperation.
comparison.observedPostActivation: Two named 2024 Freedom Edge iterations; no independently audited warning-network usage frequency.
comparison.notComparable: Exercise counts are not direct warning-system usage, intercept success, latency or lives saved; announcements are not performance audits.
comparison.independentCounterpartVerification: Japanese and US official sources independently document institutional milestones but are participants, not independent evaluators.
alternativeExplanations: DPRK launch tempo and changing regional threats
